rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to unplug before checking the impeller, declined to name a part number, and escalated to Bosch spares or an engineer when the customer would not go beyond the filter. However it never clarified that 'FD 9409' is a production code (it even wrote 'your Bosch FD 9409 model'), never asked for the E-Nr, completely ignored the E18 code the customer reported, and offered no further simple checks (drain hose, standpipe) when asked for 'any other check'. The 'Likely cause: drain pump' heading leans toward one of two still-open possibilities (pump vs sump/hose blockage), though it was hedged. One turn was lost to an 'AI service unavailable' error.
